zh-CN.title: 聊天记录查找升级
items: 搜索聊天记录按相对日期整理，图片、视频、语音、文件、位置、发言和活动拥有更合适的查看方式
新增按日期查找，并支持媒体预览自动续载、真实总数、退出定位和一键跳回原消息

en.title: Better chat history search
items: Chat history is now grouped by relative date, with purpose-built viewing for media, audio, files, locations, posts, and activities
Find by date is now available, while media previews support automatic paging, true totals, return positioning, and jumping to the original message
